name: csv_positions_cost_and_price
query: SELECT date, account, position, price, weight, cost_number WHERE account ~ 'ETrade:(GLD|Cash)' AND date >= 2017-02-15 AND date <= 2017-03-19 ORDER BY date, account, number
notes: A position column keeps only the units number per currency; the cost basis is dropped. price (an amount) is empty when NULL. cost_number is a plain decimal column.
